_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Stress metrics already maxed/static while price/F&G/funding sit mid-range inside a coil, so the skilled base-rate call is hold current rung until a named breaker fires.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both on Anxiety now; analyst explicit HOLD/Anxiety forward, narrative silent on next move
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-58 and 30d momentum stays 35-55 with ETF flows still suppressed and no range break
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks under 40 with momentum under 30 while netflow/reserves stay elevated (down to Denial), or ETF flows rebound above ~40 with momentum above 60 and skew normalizing (up to Complacency)
